blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—All it took was one message from coach Nani Epondulan for Jose Rizal University to get all the fuel it needed to drive to the NCAA Finals. “Kaya naman pala.” Those were the words Epondulan told the Heavy Bombers before they gutted out an 85-79 win over Letran in Game 2 to sweep the Knights in their Season 102 men’s basketball Final Four series at Mall of Asia Arena on Thursday. “Our players, even if they’re not talking, [we knew] they had doubts.
